method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: On the supplied instance, close f21_arg0.Healing, then f21_arg0.Wounded, then f21_arg0.Buffed, then f21_arg0.Critical, then f21_arg0.Normal, in exactly this order. No local nil/child-existence guard, explicit return, catch, rollback or repeat-close protection is supplied. Reuse the stopped constructor close registration; child/native teardown and errors remain external.
unknowns: Exact original PS4/source version matching, recovered Lua/VM fidelity and global/native/LUI provider identity remain unverified.
Model/storage/DDL/assets/localization/dvar/enum values, callback delivery/cancellation/error behavior, native networking and unavailable service/server code are separate inputs.
Other-file locals are not providers by spelling. Exact qualified global declarations are source candidates until loader/table identity and caller conditions bind them.
No implicit nil/type checks, exception recovery, timer/model disposal, idempotence or guarantee that later effects run after an error is added.

summary.answer: Initializes last-stand progress/beingRevived only if unset, then constructs health, armor, portrait, healing ability and contextual inventory views. Health/armor/portrait receive the predicted-client model when nonnil; heal receives playerGadget1. LowHealth requires health above zero and at most75. Armor repair lists accept REPAIR plus quickEquip1; health lists accept type health, unequipped0, quickEquip1. Links update the health inventory slots; constructor completion does not establish inventory actions or health mutation in gameplay.
unknowns: Exact source-to-original-PS4/build match and decompiler fidelity unverified.
Native LUI/Engine/VM/model ownership, callback delivery/order, cancellation, assets/localization/settings/DDL/storage/network/services and unavailable server code remain unverified where used.
Source-ready close body exists outside frozen allowed companion range; exact locator is retained in new_dependencies. Other class clip bodies not frozen were not authored.

Additional same-class reset/clip/close body ranges are available but outside the frozen author scope; exact locators are in unfrozen_same_class_body_locators and source-frontier.json. No body authoring or completion credit for them.

summary.answer: Creates Healing/Wounded/Buffed/Critical/Normal portrait images, each updated from nonnil CharacterSelection.characterIndex through its exact source image conversion. Health healthValue/maxHealth/maxHealthRegen and playerGadget1.state changes request state reevaluation. Critical, Wounded, Buffed and Healing predicates delegate to their specific HUD helpers. Registers close, optional postload, then SetupCharacterPortrait(self,controller), returns self. These are portrait/model consumers, not health/damage reconstruction.
unknowns: Per-body nil/error/return/lifetime limits are explicit in ordered operations; no universal cleanup, cancellation or exception recovery is inferred.
Recovered-source fidelity defects remain visible; saved AST/receipt checks are not independent correctness review.
